Depth sed.description: Sediment depth measurements in centimeters ranging from 0.72 to 78.14.

Epoch.description: Geological epoch classification of sediment core samples, limited to Pliocene and Pleistocene.

Sample label.description: Unique sediment core identifiers specifying hole, section, and depth intervals in centimeters.

Leg.description: Ocean Drilling Program expedition leg number 112.

Site.description: Site identifier 680 for the sediment core sampling location.

H.description: Single categorical value A denotes a specific sediment core identifier.

Core.description: Core identifier number ranging from 1 to 9.

Type.description: Sediment core type designated as H.

Sect.description: Sediment core section identifier ranging from one to seven.

Sect_2.description: Sediment core section identifier ranging from 5 to 130.

Sect_3.description: Sediment core section identifier ranging from 6 to 131.

Al.description: Aluminum concentration measured in sediment core samples.

Ca.description: Calcium concentration values in sediment core samples.

Fe.description: Iron concentration in sediment core samples measured in percentage.

K.description: Potassium concentration values measured in sediment core samples.

Mn.description: Manganese concentration probability scores ranging from 0.15 to 0.52.

Na.description: Sodium concentration values measured in sediment core samples.

P.description: Phosphorus concentration in sediment core samples measured in unspecified units.

Mo.description: Molybdenum concentration in sediment core samples measured in parts per million.

U.description: Uranium concentration in sediment core samples measured in parts per million.

N.description: Nitrogen concentration probability score ranging from 0.05 to 0.98.

S.description: Sulfur concentration measured in weight percent within sediment core samples.

TOC.description: Total organic carbon concentration measured in percentage units.

TC.description: Total carbon concentration measured as a percentage of dry sediment weight.

Fe/Al.description: Ratio of iron to aluminum concentrations in sediment core samples.

Mn/Al.description: Manganese to aluminum molar ratio in sediment core samples.

Mo xs.description: Molybdenum concentration measured in micrograms per gram of sediment.

U xs.description: Uranium concentration measured in parts per million within sediment core samples.

EF.description: Enrichment factor values for sediment core geochemical analysis.

EF_2.description: EF2 records sediment core elemental concentration values ranging from 1.2 to 25.12.

Feac.description: Iron abundance probability scores ranging from 0.11 to 0.85.

FeD.description: Iron concentration in sediment core samples measured in weight percent.

Femag.description: Femag probability scores ranging from 0.02 to 0.16.

Fe Py.description: Pyrite iron concentration probability scores ranging from 0.1 to 0.72.

Fe react.description: Reactive iron concentration measured in sediment core samples.

Ratio.description: Probability score quantifying the likelihood of a specific geochemical ratio occurrence.

Ratio_2.description: Second ratio probability score ranging from 0.03 to 0.5.

δ15N.description: Nitrogen isotope ratio measured in per mil units.

δ13C Corg.description: Carbon-13 isotope ratios of organic carbon measured in per mil.

δ98Mo auth.description: Authigenic molybdenum isotope ratio expressed in per mil units.

δ98Mo std dev.description: Standard deviation of molybdenum isotope ratio measurements.

Event.description: Sediment core identifier 112-680A for the entire dataset.

Latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for the sediment core sampling site.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for the sediment core sampling site.

Elevation.description: Elevation values in meters relative to a reference datum.

Date/Time.description: Sediment core sampling date and time recorded on November 5, 1986.

973695.description: Sediment core geochemical data including elemental concentrations, isotopes, and location details.

description: Single-day Earth science dataset containing 973,695 tables with 45 rows each.
